pages.name: Vodianyk
pages.text: King of the river. Only one lives on any river.

pages.title: Behaviour
pages.text: $(li)$(#A33B3B)His blows drain the air from your lungs$() (the Suffocation effect): frightening on land, deadly in water.$(li)He does not attack without reason until you cross his borders.$(li)$(#A33B3B)Within 5 blocks:$() Spirit Form switches off for 10 seconds.

pages.title: What to do
pages.text: $(#7952A6)Do not rush into the water.$() Keep a way out first.$(br2)You can cross his borders without meaning to: $(l:river/vodyanytsia)vodianytsias$(/l) may help with that.$(br2)Spirit Form will not save you near the Vodianyk: stay beyond five blocks or prepare to fight in human form.
